2610.08726.title: EgoLAP: Learning from Egocentric Human Data through Language-Action Reasoning
2610.08726.paper_summary: Egocentric human data offer a path to scaling robot learning beyond costly robot demonstrations, yet the embodiment gap makes raw human trajectories a poor supervisory target for control. Our key insight is that, although low-level actions are embodiment-specific, their underlying motion intent can capture task-relevant structure that transfers across humans and robots. We introduce EgoLAP, a VLA pre-training framework that jointly learns from human and robot trajectories through a shared language-based action chain-of-thought. EgoLAP expresses motion intent as structured, temporally abstracted language actions and pairs them with motion-level reasoning grounded in scene geometry, physics, and object affordances. Across extensive real-world and simulated experiments, EgoLAP transfers human experience to robot control more effectively than alternative action representations and reaches 80.1% mean real-world task progress, a 2.3x performance gain over alternative action representations. Motion-level reasoning also outperforms a composite reasoning format that combines subtask, object-box, and visual-trace reasoning.
2610.08726.paper_summary_zh: 自我中心的人類數據提供了一條擴展機器人學習的途徑，超越了昂貴的機器人示範，但具身差距使得原始的人類軌跡成為控制的劣質監督目標。我們的關鍵見解是，雖然低層次的行動是具身特定的，但其潛在的運動意圖可以捕捉到跨越人類和機器人的任務相關結構。我們介紹了EgoLAP，一個VLA預訓練框架，通過基於共享語言的行動思維鏈共同學習人類和機器人的軌跡。EgoLAP將運動意圖表達為結構化的、時間上抽象的語言行動，並將其與基於場景幾何、物理學和物體可供性所根據的運動層次推理配對。在廣泛的現實世界和模擬實驗中，EgoLAP比替代的行動表示更有效地將人類經驗轉移到機器人控制上，並達到了80.1%的平均現實世界任務進展，相較於替代行動表示有2.3倍的性能提升。運動層次推理也超越了一種結合子任務、物體框和視覺痕跡推理的綜合推理格式。
